text:
maria: kicking off a focused thread to finalize UI + policy for Dedicated burst ledger and autoscale safety for Q3 roadmap. main things: how we present burst consumption, carryover rules, and safe defaults for autoscale/preempt.

ajay: suggestion: surface a simple "remaining USD-minutes" counter in Console + detailed ledger view for billing. SKUs = micro/team/enterprise.

ben: infra constraints reminder: cold-starts 2-4m for big models, KV drain ~30s. suggest default cooldown=180s and feature-flagged aggressive profile for enterprise.

tal: UX: make carryover opt-in on purchase flow and show a tooltip: "Carryover preserves unused burst up to X months". ledger should be downloadable as CSV.

sophia: legal/finance: carryover allowed only with explicit opt-in and audit record. internal metric = USD-minutes. Billing needs invoice-friendly IDs.

nova: support note: soft-quota with clear 429 + "try fallback model" CTA reduces tickets. We should also log quota-rejection reasons for SRE.

ajay: burst windows: micro=10m, team=30m, enterprise=24h (enterprise may opt into monthly carryover). pricing in USD-minutes, show token equivalent for transparency.

ben: rough deploy plan: implement ledger + soft-quota hooks -> UI -> billing integration -> carryover opt-in. estimate 4 backend sprints + 1 UI + 1 QA. roll out behind feature flag.

maria: decisions for roadmap doc: (1) show USD-minutes counter + ledger download, (2) tiered windows per SKU, (3) carryover opt-in only for enterprise, (4) soft-quota default and hard-block via contract, (5) cooldown=180s.

ops-bot: calendar event created: "Dedicated Burst Ledger Review" Fri 9:00. Invite sent.

maria: assigning action items: Ben -> sprint breakdown & risk by Tue EOD; Ajay -> draft pricing table + SLO targets; Tal -> console mock + purchase flow copy Tue; Sophia -> opt-in legal wording + billing IDs Tue; Nova -> support playbook draft Wed. Add comments if anything missing.

maria: thanks :thumbsup:
